name: ZH-M3 Wall Mounted Vending Machine
description: A compact wall-mounted vending machine with a 21.5-inch portrait touchscreen and a narrow product-viewing window, designed for locations where floor space is limited.
recommendedUse: Offices, hotels and compact retail spaces
specs: Card, cash, coin and scan-payment options
applications: A space-saving option for small packaged products. The wall-mounted cabinet, payment configuration, exterior finish and channel layout can be specified for the target site and assortment.
benefit: Full touchscreen vending in a wall-mounted format

name: ZH-T5 Large Vertical Big Screen Vending Machine
description: A floor-standing vending machine built around a large 55-inch HD touchscreen, combining product selection, payment and digital advertising in one front-facing display.
recommendedUse: Malls, transit hubs and high-traffic venues
specs: Card, cash, coin and scan-payment options
applications: Designed for sites that need strong on-machine merchandising. The large display can support product browsing, promotions and branded content alongside a configurable payment and dispensing system.
benefit: Large-format advertising and vending in one cabinet

name: ZH-T4 Large Vertical Vending Machine
description: A large-window floor-standing vending machine with a 21.5-inch portrait touchscreen and flexible dispensing lanes for a broad range of packaged goods.
applications: A general-purpose platform for snacks, beverages and packaged retail products. Lane type and shelf layout can be adjusted to suit different product dimensions.
benefit: High product visibility with flexible lane options

name: ZH-S102 Elevator Vending Machine for Hot Food
description: A 21.5-inch touchscreen vending machine with XY-axis addressing, elevator delivery and a full-height glass display for larger or more delicate packaged products.
applications: The elevator moves selected products to the pickup area with less drop distance. Heating, refrigeration and food-service requirements should be confirmed for the intended assortment and market.
benefit: Elevator delivery for food and delicate products

name: ZH-S6 Elevator Vending Machine
description: A large-capacity intelligent vending machine with a 21.5-inch touchscreen and elevator delivery for controlled handling of mixed packaged products.
applications: Suitable for mixed assortments that benefit from a gentler journey to the collection bay. Product lanes, payment hardware and cooling can be configured for the deployment.
benefit: Controlled elevator delivery for mixed products

name: ZH-S4 Elevator Snack Vending Machine
description: A 21.5-inch touchscreen snack vending machine with an elevator and automatic delivery door for reliable handoff at the pickup bay.
recommendedUse: Snack retail in offices, schools and public venues
applications: Configured for packaged snacks and drinks where an automatic pickup door and elevator delivery improve product handling and the customer experience.
